_comment: The inputs the placement and leak gates render with. Acme is not a real
site and never becomes one: this tree is placed into a temp directory,
asserted against, and deleted. The values are chosen to be AWKWARD rather
than tidy — a site name with an apostrophe and an ampersand (both legal in
the card's pattern, both special in TypeScript strings and XML), a
hyphenated repo slug that CONTAINS the word `portfolio`, an owner other
than the baseline's, and NO domain — a console build asks for none, so the
placeholder <reponame>.example.com is what a site is born with — because a
fixture that only uses values the templates were written against proves
the templates work on the values they were written against.
Every key here is an input repo-blueprint.yaml declares. A key it does not
declare is a fixture that has drifted, and orun refuses it.
